HOW TO USE

Make cheap small drafts until one looks right, THEN spend the time on the big final picture. Pause Image stops the Run at the draft, so the slow part only runs for the draft you chose.

 Steps

  1. Write your prompt and press Run. The Run stops at Pause Image Pixaroma and shows a draft (about 1 s).
  2. Do not like it? Press Run again (the seed is Random) for a new draft.
  3. Like it? Press Continue on the Pause node. Only the final part runs: Klein redraws your draft at 1536 px with sharp detail, and the Preview saves it.

 Good to know

  • The final keeps the composition of the draft, and adds detail. Small things can still change a little, like a sign or a face in the distance.
  • Want everything in one Run, no stop? Switch the gate to Pass.
  • The same gate works in front of anything slow: an upscale, a video, a second model.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Nodes look different from the video

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load Diffusion Model (Flux 2 Klein 9B) - The image model, Flux 2 Klein 9B from Black Forest Labs. It is a fast 4-step model that can make a picture from words AND change a picture you give it.
  • Load CLIP (Qwen 3 8B, reads the prompt) - Reads your prompt and turns the words into something the image model understands.
  • Load VAE (Flux 2) - Turns the finished render into a picture you can see, and a picture into the model's own format.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Prompt Pixaroma (1. your prompt) - The prompt box. Type what you want.
  • Sizes Pixaroma (2. draft size, small and fast) - The DRAFT size: small, so a draft takes about 1 second.
  • Seed Pixaroma (3. Random gives a new draft) - On R (random), so each Run is a new draft until you find one you like.
  • Pause Image Pixaroma (4. check the draft, then Continue) - The gate. On Pause, the Run stops here and shows the draft: nothing after it runs. Press Continue on the node and only the part AFTER it runs, using the draft you are looking at. Regenerate makes a new draft. Pass runs everything in one go.
  • Longest Side Pixaroma (5. final size) - The FINAL size: the longest side of the draft becomes 1536 (or 2048 with the button), keeping its shape. It also sets the size of the big canvas.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • CLIP Text Encode (reads the prompt) - Reads the prompt through the text encoder.
  • ConditioningZeroOut (empty negative) - An empty negative prompt. Klein runs at CFG 1, where the negative does nothing, but the KSampler still needs one plugged in.
  • Empty Flux 2 Latent (blank canvas) - The blank canvas the picture is painted on, at the size it receives.
  • KSampler (4 steps) - The render: 4 steps, CFG 1, euler, simple, the settings Klein is made for.
  • VAE Decode (latent to picture) - Turns the finished render into a picture.
  • CLIP Text Encode (reads the finishing prompt) - Reads the finishing prompt.
  • ConditioningZeroOut (empty negative) - An empty negative prompt for the final render.
  • VAE Encode (the draft as a reference) - Turns the enlarged draft into the model's format, so Klein can redraw it.
  • ReferenceLatent (the draft, positive) - Hands the draft to Klein as the picture to redraw (one for the prompt, one for the negative).
  • ReferenceLatent (the draft, negative) - The same draft, for the empty negative.
  • Empty Flux 2 Latent (big canvas) - The big blank canvas, at the final size.
  • KSampler (final, 4 steps) - The final render: 4 steps at the big size.
  • VAE Decode (the final picture) - Turns the final render into the finished picture.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Preview Image Pixaroma (the final, saved) - Shows the final picture and saves it into ComfyUI/output/Draft Then Finish.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Text Join Two Pixaroma (finishing words + your prompt) - The finishing prompt: the words in field 1 ask Klein to keep the picture and redraw it sharp at the big size, and field 2 is your own prompt, so the light and colors stay the same.
  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the number of pictures and their size.

PartSizeTime
Draft896 x 640about 1 s
Final (after Continue)1536 x 1104about 5 s

Klein needs 4 steps, so it is fast: about 1.7 s for a 1024 x 1024 picture from a prompt and about 3 s for an edit at 1 megapixel, where it also reads your picture.

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models from disk (about 18 GB for Klein and its text encoder), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.

 On a 16 GB card

Timed on an RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB with 32 GB of RAM:

  • Klein took about 3 to 6 times as long, about 10 s even for one picture: Klein and its text encoder (17 GB together) do not fit in 16 GB, so parts of them load again on every Run, and a second Run is no faster.
